en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly, terraced landscape with vineyards and scattered houses. On the upper left stands a large multi‑storey modernist hotel building on the hillside. On the upper right there is a tall monument or statue on a small peak. The foreground shows a road with a rustic wooden guardrail curving along the slope. The reverse side is a divided postcard back with printed Hungarian text indicating Pécs and the Mecsek Hotel, a postmark, and publisher information.
